basic_info.description: This move-in ready single-family home has been completely renovated with care and style. Enjoy beautiful hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and a fully remodeled kitchen featuring stunning countertops and custom cabinetry. The renovated bathroom adds modern comfort, while the oversized flat backyard is perfect for entertaining, gardening, or relaxing in the sun.    Take in incredible views of the city, surrounding hills, and sparkling water from multiple vantage points. A large garage offers excellent storage, and the home's convenient location puts everything you need within easy reach. This is a rare opportunity to own a beautifully upgraded home with space, charm, and scenery. Disclosures Link: https://app.disclosures.io/link/263-Madison-Street-3u7v114w
